name: NorCal CARB Mobile — Hayward/SL Cold Email Outreach

blueprint.description: Reads leads from Google Sheets, sends personalized cold emails from bryan@norcalcarbmobile.com via SMTP, logs send status back to the sheet. 22 leads, ~1 email/min pacing.

trigger.note: Run manually or schedule. Each run processes all unsent rows.

modules.name: Read Leads from Google Sheets
modules.notes: Only processes rows where Email_Sent is empty. Sort by score so HOT leads send first.

modules.name: Pace Sends (60s between emails)
modules.notes: 60-second delay between emails to avoid spam filters. 22 leads = ~22 minutes total. Adjust down to 30s if you want faster.

modules.name: Send Personalized Email

smtpSetup.note: Set up SMTP connection in Make.com with these settings:
smtpSetup.host: YOUR_SMTP_HOST (e.g., smtp.gmail.com for Google Workspace, or your email provider)

modules.notes: Sends from bryan@norcalcarbmobile.com. Subject and body pulled from the sheet row.

modules.name: Log Send Status to Sheet
modules.notes: Stamps the date/time into Email_Sent column so the row won't be picked up on the next run.

step1_createSheet.title: Upload the email CSV to Google Sheets
step1_createSheet.detail: Upload 'leads/hayward-san-leandro-email-outreach.csv' to Google Sheets as a new sheet named 'Email_Outreach'. This has all 22 leads with personalized subject lines and email bodies pre-filled.

step2_fillEmails.title: Fill in the Email column
step2_fillEmails.detail: The Email column has placeholder values. Look up each company's email (from their website, Google listing, or your contacts) and paste it in. Skip any you can't find — you'll call those instead.

step3_createScenario.title: Import blueprint into Make.com
step3_createScenario.detail: In Make.com: Create a new scenario → click the three dots → Import Blueprint → paste this JSON. Then configure the SMTP connection with your norcalcarbmobile.com email credentials.

step4_configureSMTP.title: Set up SMTP connection
step4_configureSMTP.detail: In the Email module, create a new SMTP connection. If norcalcarbmobile.com is on Google Workspace: host=smtp.gmail.com, port=587, TLS, use an App Password (not your regular password). If on another provider, use their SMTP settings.

step5_connectSheets.title: Connect Google Sheets
step5_connectSheets.detail: In both the 'Read Leads' and 'Log Send Status' modules, connect your Google account and select the spreadsheet you created in Step 1.

step6_testAndRun.title: Test with one row, then run all
step6_testAndRun.detail: Set the Google Sheets filter to limit=1 for a test run. Send to yourself first by putting your email in row 2. Once confirmed, set limit back to 50 and run the full batch.

creditsEstimate.note: Each lead uses ~4 operations (read + sleep + send + log). 22 leads = ~88 operations. You have 10,000 credits — this barely touches them.

alternativeApproach_Gmail.note: If SMTP is tricky to set up, you can use the Gmail module instead of the Email module. It's simpler — just authorize your Google account. The Gmail module uses OAuth so no app password needed.
